purpose: Teach: 歯車/一心/下ろす/見下ろす/談義/植生/フラグ/のむ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の、本気で、絶対、歯車、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、感じるよ
lines.en: Aoi, I can really feel how much heart you're putting into this place.
lines.style: Warm observation, soft admiration. Leans in with genuine recognition. Voice opens gently, settles into certainty by the end. No performance—just honest seeing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、お料理に、絶対、一心、絶対、に、絶対、取り組んでるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. I'm really throwing everything into the cooking and the whole operation.
lines.style: Simple affirmation, grounded. Speaks from the center of herself without defensiveness. Steady pace, slight pause before the second thought—like she's admitting something true she doesn't often say out loud.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お店の、絶対、荷物、絶対、下ろす、絶対、のは、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、お手伝いするわよ
lines.en: Let me help you carry things up from downstairs. I want to be useful here.
lines.style: Tender offer wrapped in gentle insistence. Softly firm—not asking permission, extending an arm. Voice stays close and warm, trailing slightly on the verb to make room for Aoi to accept.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお店の二階から、本気で、絶対、街、絶対、見下ろす、絶対、景色、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、お洒落でしょ?本気で
lines.en: The view from upstairs really is beautiful, isn't it? You can see the whole town from there.
lines.style: Reflective, almost surprised by her own thought. Gazes past the moment for a second. Quiet wonder in the tone—inviting Mei to see it too, not performing the beauty but feeling it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気for、絶対、お客様と、絶対、お料理、絶対、談義、絶対、楽しんでるね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: I love how you talk with customers about the food. You really bring people in with that.
lines.style: Genuine praise, specific and unhurried. Voice settles into each word like she's noticing something she's been meaning to say. Warm attention without urgency—this matters, and she has time.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お店の周りの、絶対、植生、絶対、お祖父さまから、絶対、教わったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: My grandfather taught me a lot about the plants around here, actually.
lines.style: Thoughtful aside, slightly tender. Shifts inward at the mention of him—voice softens but doesn't break. Grateful reflection, like she's carrying something forward. Pace slows just enough to honor the memory.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のメニュー、本気で、絶対、新作、絶対、フラグ、絶対、立ってるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your new menu items—I can already tell they're going to be a hit.
lines.style: Light certainty, touched with playful knowing. Quick bright attack, then settles into enthusiasm. Voice carries the lightness of someone who sees ahead and is delighted by what she sees.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、新酒、絶対、お客様と、絶対、のむ、絶対、機会、絶対、楽しみよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'm really looking forward to tasting new sake with customers. That'll be special.
lines.style: Eager but grounded, gazing toward something. Voice opens with anticipation but doesn't rush. Slight lift on the final thought—the pleasure of small future moments already warming her voice.
